description: A Collie Client's hello passing the configuration-only key `storage.low_free` in code, refused with `setting_not_applicable` naming the user configuration and Operator policy files (ADR 0083), which ends the exchange. The `settings-refusals-say-how-to-fix` client conformance case.

error.message: `storage.low_free` cannot be set in run: set `storage.low_free` in user configuration, `/home/user/.config/goodfetch/1/configuration.toml`, or an Operator policy, `/home/user/.config/goodfetch/1/operator-policy.toml`

data.fix: set `storage.low_free` in user configuration, `/home/user/.config/goodfetch/1/configuration.toml`, or an Operator policy, `/home/user/.config/goodfetch/1/operator-policy.toml`
